title: Vehicle Asset Properties
description: Category-specific properties for vehicles: cars, motorcycles, boats, caravans, classic vehicles
$comment: This schema is composed with asset.json via allOf+if/then. Do NOT use additionalProperties:false here — it would reject core asset fields.

vehicle.description: Structured vehicle data — identity, registration, and estate administration tracking. Present when category is 'vehicle'. Maps to schema:Vehicle in JSON-LD

registrationNumber.description: Vehicle registration number (number plate). Primary UK identifier. Format varies by jurisdiction

vin.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number. International standard, globally unique per vehicle

make.description: Vehicle manufacturer. Use the DVLA-registered name where available

model.description: Vehicle model name. DVLA VES API does not return this — must come from user input or VIN decode

dateOfFirstRegistration.description: Date of first registration in the UK (or equivalent jurisdiction)

fuelType.description: Fuel type as reported by DVLA

engineCapacity.description: Engine capacity in cubic centimetres (cc). Zero for electric vehicles

co2Emissions.description: CO2 emissions in grams per kilometre

vehicleType.$comment: car: standard passenger car. motorcycle: two-wheeled motorcycle. van: light commercial vehicle. motorhome: campervan or motorhome. trike: three-wheeled vehicle. sidecar_outfit: motorcycle with sidecar. other: any type not listed

isClassic.description: Whether the vehicle is considered a classic or historic vehicle. In the UK, vehicles manufactured before 1 January 1977 are exempt from vehicle excise duty. Classic vehicles may need specialist valuation (Hagerty, auction houses) rather than standard guides

keeperStatus.description: Whether the deceased was the registered keeper of this vehicle

v5cStatus.description: Status of the V5C registration document (logbook)
v5cStatus.$comment: held: the estate has the V5C. missing: the V5C cannot be found — apply for a replacement using V62. applied_for: a replacement has been applied for. with_dvla: the V5C is currently with DVLA (e.g. during a transfer)

financeType.description: Type of finance arrangement on the vehicle. If HP or PCP, the vehicle is owned by the finance company, not the estate
financeType.$comment: none: no finance — vehicle is owned outright. hp: hire purchase — finance company owns until final payment. pcp: personal contract purchase — finance company owns, balloon payment to retain. lease: personal or business lease — must be returned. loan: unsecured loan used to buy — vehicle is owned, loan is a separate liability. unknown: finance status not yet checked

sornDeclared.description: Whether a Statutory Off Road Notification (SORN) is currently in effect

deathActions.description: Tracks which estate administration steps have been completed for this vehicle

dvlaNotified.description: Whether DVLA has been notified of the keeper's death

insurerNotified.description: Whether the vehicle insurer has been notified

financeCompanyNotified.description: Whether the finance company has been notified (if applicable)

financeSettled.description: Whether the finance has been settled or the vehicle returned

taxRefundClaimed.description: Whether a refund has been claimed for remaining full months of vehicle tax

intendedDisposal.description: What the executor intends to do with the vehicle

vehicleCheck.description: Live vehicle check data from DVLA VES, DVSA MOT History, and HPI/finance check APIs. Point-in-time snapshot at retrievedAt

retrievedAt.description: When this check data was fetched

lastMileageDate.description: Date of the last MOT mileage reading

advisoryCount.description: Number of advisory items at last MOT

failureCount.description: Number of failure items at last MOT

insuranceStatus.description: Whether the vehicle appears insured on the Motor Insurance Database

financeOutstanding.description: Whether there is outstanding finance on the vehicle

financeSettlementAmount.description: Finance settlement figure in minor units (pennies). The amount needed to clear the finance and take ownership

writeOffCategory.$comment: A: scrap only, must be crushed, zero value. B: body must be crushed, parts can be salvaged. S: structural damage, repairable (formerly Cat C). N: non-structural damage, repairable (formerly Cat D). none: not written off

stolenStatus.description: Whether the vehicle is reported stolen

plateChanges.description: Number of registration plate changes in the vehicle's history

mileageAnomaly.description: Whether MOT mileage readings show a discrepancy (clocking indicator)
